notes.text:
This update for systemd fixes the following issues

Security issues fixed:

- CVE-2026-40226: nspawn: escape-to-host via malformed optional config file (bsc#1261400).

Other updates and bugfixes:

- Import commit 260e668bfa (bsc#1267647 bsc#1262305 bsc#1267644).
- Import commit 58e5d2e21e (bsc#1261982).
- Import commit 4bd91117cc (bsc#1261983).

notes.text: In nspawn in systemd 233 through 259 before 260, an escape-to-host action can occur via a crafted optional config file.
